Definition: from G114; cancellation (literally or figuratively):--disannulling, put away.
BiblicalUsage: There is a disannulling of the commandment that went before, because it was weak and unprofitable, and Christ appeared once to put away sin by the sacrifice of Himself. The word means cancellation, a setting aside that clears the way.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the old commandment was set aside so that a better hope could come in, and the sin it could not remove was put away by His blood.
